data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund €793
data.summary: The tax office (Finanzamt) Musterhafen issued the 2025 income tax assessment. Income tax is €4,402.00, and after withheld wage tax of €5,195.00 you get a refund of €793.00.
data.explanation: This is your income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025. Because more wage tax was withheld than you owe, you get a refund of €793.00, which will be paid to your known bank account in the next few days. Check that the figures match your tax return. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically, or state it in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. If you agree, nothing needs to be done.
